# Mending the sleeve before it frays

Nessa showed me how to reinforce a thin elbow before a hole appears. I had waited for visible failure because that felt like evidence that a repair was needed. The extra stitches are almost invisible now and will be easier than a patch later. Put a photograph in [[Maintenance]]. Preventive work is difficult to notice precisely because the expected failure does not arrive.
